description: The Mechanical Engineering branch at Canara Engineering College was established in 2004 with an initial intake of 60 students, with a vision to cultivate technically proficient and industry-ready engineers. The program has earned distinction by being accredited twice by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA), reflecting its commitment to academic excellence, quality education, and continuous improvement.

Recognized as one of the most versatile and expansive engineering disciplines, Mechanical Engineering provides a strong foundation that enables graduates to excel across a wide spectrum of technological domains. The curriculum is thoughtfully designed to integrate core engineering fundamentals with emerging technologies, preparing students for diverse professional pathways such as Aeronautics, Aerospace, Power Generation, Energy Conversion and Conservation, Transportation Systems, Advanced Manufacturing, Product Design, Robotics, Automation, and Intelligent Control Systems. This multidisciplinary approach equips learners not only with robust technical expertise but also with analytical, innovative, and problem-solving skills essential for success in today’s rapidly evolving global engineering environment.

Our alumni serve in responsible and high-ranking positions in leading core mechanical industries across the world, a testament to the department’s strong academic foundation, industry-oriented training, and commitment to professional excellence.

depatmentHead.messageFromtheDepartmentHead: Mechanical Engineering Department is one of the most active and most happening Departments in CEC. It is one of the very few departments around Mangalore that has the Industrial CNC Machining centres. A team of 01 Associate Professor and 05 Assistant Professors are working with passion and dedication to ensure career oriented Total Quality Education. To meet such a feat the Department has introduced additional labs on Advanced Material testing, CNC operation, Dissection lab, Bio diesel Processing lab, Computer Aided Modelling Lab (On AutoCAD, SolidWorks and Creo Software) with an objective to provide the practical exposure to students. The Department organizes many Workshops, Webinars and Faculty Development Programmes in variety of domains for the benefit of Students and Faculty. The Department has MoU with MNCs who visit the department to impart career-oriented training. We are totally focussed on Outcome based education (OBE) via Industrial Internships and Product development centres. Exclusive work is being carried out on Electric vehicles in association of Electrical Department. A research project funded by the Department of Science and Technology (DST) with a grant of ₹30 lakhs, sanctioned in 2023, was successfully completed in 2025 in the field of plastic recycling. These are new fields where the Department is working to make students Industry ready.

careerProspects.title: Mechanical Engineering in the New Advanced Era
careerProspects.marketOverview: Mechanical Engineering, often regarded as the backbone of technological civilization, continues to evolve as one of the most dynamic and future ready engineering disciplines. In the new era of rapid technological advancement, globalization, automation, and sustainability, mechanical engineers are no longer confined to traditional industries, they are innovators, designers, analysts, and problem-solvers shaping the future of modern society.
careerProspects.careerOpportunities:
Mechanical engineers remain among the most globally employable professionals. Their expertise is required in manufacturing, energy, infrastructure, healthcare equipment, transportation, research laboratories, and emerging tech startups. With industries transitioning toward Industry 4.0 and smart factories, the demand for engineers who can combine mechanical knowledge with digital intelligence is steadily increasing worldwide.

Mechanical Engineering also nurtures entrepreneurial thinking. With knowledge of design, manufacturing, and systems engineering, graduates can establish startups in product design, fabrication, automation solutions, renewable energy devices, or consultancy services.

This project aims to develop process and optimization for recycling of plastic waste and coated paper waste for producing filament stocks for 3D printing, and granules for plastic industries as a replacement for the virgin plastic granules. The successful execution aids in replacing virgin plastics with recycled plastics in the plastic industries.
